# discord_webhook (Data Source)

Reads a single Discord webhook by ID. The token is not exposed by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_webhook" "deploys" {
  id = "987654321098765432"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Snowflake ID of the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String) Webhook avatar hash.
- `channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the channel.
- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild.
- `name` (String) Webhook name.
- `type` (Number) Webhook type.
